sources.note: Main vendor homepage. Markets eMedPractice as 'Complete All-In-One Integrated Medical Software' for enterprise healthcare. Heavy on marketing, light on detailed feature descriptions.
ONC mandatory disclosures page. Confirms ONC-ACB certification status. Actual page content was mostly CSS/structural — limited substantive product info extractable.

Service/login portal. Lists core products (EHR, PM, Clearinghouse, MIPS Registry). Describes AI ScribeSync ($99/mo ambient documentation) and eFax with AI features. Confirms 2015 Edition Stage 3 certification.

Practice page with feature details: financial dashboard, CDC growth charts, immunizations, vital signs, document management, faxing, bidirectional lab integration, registration kiosk, appointment reminders, e-payments.

Integrated EHR page. Describes end-to-end workflow from scheduling through claims/payment posting. Details insurance verification, e-prescribing with EPCS, lab integration, clearinghouse with claims validation, EOB auto-posting, HISP secure messaging.
Enterprise page. Emphasizes 'Predictive Analytics & Intelligent Automation' and scalable data management. Actual content was mostly styling — limited extractable detail.

FindEMR profile. Describes cloud-based EHR + PM + billing platform. Lists specialties: behavioral health, allergy, cardiology, chiropractic, dermatology, gastroenterology, neurology, ophthalmology, pediatrics. Pricing tiers $249–2.99%/month.

SoftwareFinder profile. Confirms EHR, e-prescription, lab, RCM integration. Three pricing tiers (Silver/Gold/Platinum). Notes third-party integrations: rater8, NLSQL, Juno Health, SHOTSTracker. User feedback mentions occasional slow support response.
Capterra listing (blocked by 403 during fetch). Search results confirmed reviews exist praising customization and ease of use; some complaints about clunky interface for scribes.
Software Advice listing (blocked by 403 during fetch). Confirmed via search results as a review source for eMedicalPractice.
LinkedIn company page (not fetched directly). Search results indicate company reports 201-500 employees on LinkedIn.
ZoomInfo profile (not fetched directly). Search results report 11-50 employees, conflicting with LinkedIn's 201-500 figure.
Alternate domain — redirects (301) to emedpractice.com. Same company/product.
